prompt: A cinematic close-up portrait of a girl, slightly grainy. She stands against a dark grey matte wall. Her makeup has a soft glow, glossy full lips, mascara, and black eyeliner. Her hair is long, straight, and Old Money-styled, falling to her waist, with a few strands across her face from the wind. She wears a chunky grey knit sweater with dark red stripes, one shoulder bare, and loose dark red jeans with raw edges. She is drinking an iced latte from a dark red cardboard cup. She has a slight closed-mouth smile. Daylight with some shadow. 9:16 format. Short square nails in a light color. Shot with flash.

translations.zh: 女孩手拿深红色纸杯冰拿铁靠在深灰色哑光墙前的电影感微颗粒特写肖像。她化着微光妆容、丰满唇彩与眼线，留着长直发，穿着红灰条纹厚针织毛衣和深红色宽松牛仔裤，带着微笑，光线为日光与闪光灯。
